crop_profile.name: Rice

hazard_warnings.heat_risk: Sterility risk if temperatures exceed 38°C during anthesis
hazard_warnings.moisture_risk: High sensitivity to drought during panicle initiation
hazard_warnings.pest_alert: Brown Plant Hopper (BPH) and Blast fungus during high humidity

crop_profile.market_notes: High demand in NCR region; supported by Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Basmati and Non-Basmati varieties.
crop_profile.llm_reasoning: Coordinates place the farm in the Indo-Gangetic plain where rice requires high soil saturation (puddling) to minimize percolation. Heat ceilings are set to 38°C to account for the critical temperature threshold that triggers pollen sterility in tropical cultivars.

rotation_history.soil_legacy: Preceding crop before rotation to Rice. Residual nutrient drawdown and root biomass.
Puddled anaerobic soil created subsoil compaction; depleted Nitrogen to 29 mg/kg; high water extraction
Leguminous pulse fixed biological Nitrogen (~30 kg N/ha); low water consumption
